title: Bolder hand
question: Foreign forms only, at full commitment. Every direction from the first round is eliminated.

options.label: Safelight Bay
options.lineage: a printing darkroom under amber safelight, timed baths and drying lines
options.thesis: A sourcing run is a print coming up in the tray, so the interface is a bay of fixed stations where offers emerge under timed development and pass a point after which nothing can be pulled back.
options.viewport: An amber-washed bay with six stations ruled left to right, the live one lit and the rest dim. Offers develop in place from grey ghost to full value as replies land, and the commit point is a hard rule no station crosses backwards.
options.risk: Amber safelight overrides Aonic's pinned off-white ground, and the emergence effect can read as a loading state with extra steps.

raised.raise: Every state is a strict palette law, so pass, pending, flagged and void are never told apart by position alone.

regions.label: station rail: compose, expose, develop, fix, wash, dry

options.label: Command Wall
options.lineage: a nineties mecha-anime crisis wall, hazard chevrons and monumental seven-segment counters
options.thesis: Sourcing is a set of limits being approached, so every reading is a condition bar creeping toward its ceiling, and the frame itself bands with hazard chevrons the moment one crosses.
materials: framed label blocks on leader lines
options.viewport: A central schematic of the ingredient with leader lines running out to framed blocks at the edges, each holding one reading as a condition bar filling toward its limit. A seven-segment counter holds the live delivered price at monumental scale, and a breach bands the whole frame.
options.case: Beats the leader on both axes. Product clarity: a heavy metal reading against a ceiling, a price against a guardrail and a countdown to a silent supplier are literally what this grammar was built to display. Audience identification: a buyer watching limits is the exact posture this wall assumes.
options.risk: The source is phosphor on absolute black, which refuses Aonic's pinned off-white. Translated to daylight it keeps the structure and loses the glow, and the untranslated version is available if you release the brand pin.

options.label: Breathing Column
options.lineage: a tensegrity column of carbon rods and red cord held by opposing forces
options.thesis: A negotiation is two forces in balance, so each offer renders as a strut network where our ceiling pulls against their floor and the agreed price is the point the structure settles at.
options.viewport: A force diagram fills the page, each supplier a strut with a red cord under tension, labelled with its value, and the layout obeying the network rather than a page grid.
options.case: Holds product clarity on negotiation: every counter-offer visibly changes the tension, and a stalled supplier renders as a failed member. Loses audience identification, and it has no vocabulary for a laboratory limit table.
options.risk: Half the product is tabular certificate data that no force diagram can hold.

options.label: Coupon Book
options.lineage: a jet-age airline ticket wallet of carbon-copy coupons and baggage stubs
options.thesis: Each supplier is a coupon in one wallet, torn off in sequence, and a rejected offer never disappears, it stamps itself VOID and stays in the book.
options.viewport: A wallet of tabbed coupons, one supplier per sheet, each ruled into fare boxes holding price, lead time and origin, with the used and cancelled ones stamped and still in place.
options.case: Holds audience identification outright: a buyer reads coupon books, stamps and sequence without being taught. Loses on boldness, because it sits in the same document family as the direction you just rolled away from.
options.risk: It is adjacent to The Carbon Set, so it may read as the rejected round returning in a different uniform.

options.label: Phosphor Cabinet
options.lineage: a pixel-art arcade cabinet screen with scanlines and phosphor bloom
options.thesis: Every state is a sprite swap under strict palette law.
options.viewport: A tile grid with eight-by-eight pixel caps pinned to the top edge.
options.case: Loses both axes: a buyer committing company money reads pixel art as a toy, and an eight-by-eight face cannot set a four-decimal heavy metal reading.
options.kept: Palette discipline as law. Every state has one colour and only that colour.
options.risk: Undermines the trust the product exists to earn.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: a silk cape with hidden drawcord channels that gather a flat plane into volume
options.thesis: One pull gathers the flat brief into a shaped result.
options.viewport: A black semicircle with a single gold cord running its radius.
options.case: Loses both axes: the transformation is the whole idea and this product has no single moment of transformation, it has a long process with many small states.
options.kept: One control visibly propagating through every linked region.
options.risk: A beautiful gesture with nothing in the task for it to do.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The procurement dashboard every vendor ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A left nav rail, four summary tiles across the top and a sortable table below.
canonCard.risk: A reviewer has seen it a hundred times and will remember nothing about it.
